title: normalizeName keeps surrounding whitespace
issue_text: normalizeName should trim surrounding whitespace before lower-casing a name.
expected_patch_hint: Trim the value before lower-casing it.

title: takeWindow returns one element too many
issue_text: takeWindow should return exactly limit elements starting at offset.

files.src/window.ts: export const takeWindow = <T>(items: T[], offset: number, limit: number) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit + 1);

expected_patch_hint: Remove the extra one from the slice end.

changes.content: export const takeWindow = <T>(items: T[], offset: number, limit: number) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit);

assertions.equals: export const takeWindow = <T>(items: T[], offset: number, limit: number) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit);
